root_cause: The dialog's autofocus attribute is not honored when opening via showModal(), causing focus to remain outside the dialog after it opens.
repair_strategy: After showing the dialog (showModal/show), explicitly focus the element with the autofocus attribute, falling back to the dialog itself if none found.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard focus moves into the drawer when opened, allowing users to interact with filters without a pointer.
functional_risks: Potential focus theft if autofocus element is not focusable.
Risk of double-focus if browser already moved focus (mitigated by checking existence).
verification_requirements: After activating the drawer button with Enter, focus is on #filters-search.
Pressing Tab moves focus to #in-stock checkbox.
Closing the drawer with Escape returns focus to the trigger button.
